usedFor: WooCommerce holds your store orders, and Kylas CRM keeps the leads when “Order Updated” runs “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Updated” in WooCommerce, then “Create or Update Lead” in Kylas CRM
bestTemplate.why: Buyers reach your sales team as leads, and a matching phone or email updates the lead instead of duplicating it.

watchOut: “Order Updated” fires on every edit to an order, so the same buyer can reach Kylas CRM several times.
